item.title: Ramp Opens Token Spend Management and Router to External Customers
item.summary: Ramp has opened its internal AI cost tools — Token Spend Management and Router — to external customers, while disclosing that its in-house coding agent Inspect has crossed 1M+ sessions and handles 75% of merged pull requests, per co-founder Karim Atiyeh's post amplified by Khosla Ventures' Keith Rabois.
